scope: Physical Gazebo/ROS execution and backend/UI consistency; uncalibrated synthetic models, not agricultural validation or algorithm-ranking study.

matrix.scope: Final guard and final checker, observation seed 72. Success means task success; severe failed/1 with 0/3 truth-verified tasks.

friction_contrast.scope: Five paired repetitions across development rounds; same fixed geometry and route within each pair, all use truth control and do not invoke the changed localization guard. No raised step or overlapping ground plane. Wheel/truth disagreement is not a calibrated tyre slip ratio.

integration.scope: Reference/fault paths do not invoke the nonideal innovation guard. These nine runs preceded its final fix; per-session sources are preserved.

export.scope: Record content only; four UI executions are retained, not four trials of the final guard.

software.scope: Final backend full suite and pure model guard tests passed. Frontend and 15 engineering gates passed before the final backend-only guard fix; their code was unchanged. Exact pushed main SHA is checked by GitHub CI.

further_recheck.scope: Pre-angular-gate records independently rechecked without overwriting original results. Final guard matrix and latest UI ran live with the final angular checker and guard.

stress_findings: Final guard seed 72: outage hold/resume succeeded with 3/3 truth-verified; severe failed/1 after persistent anomaly, controller completed 1/3 but truth certified 0/3.
Pre-final-guard seed 74 outage_hold: hold/resume succeeded, but task 1 failed position tolerance before the outage; 2/3 truth-verified, failed/1. This earlier failure is retained and not overwritten.

All three earlier severe cases failed/1. Earlier seed 72 controller claimed 3/3 while truth certified 0/3; seeds 73/74 stopped after persistent innovation anomalies. An emitted zero command is not a verified stationary body.
model_limits: Ground friction proxy only: no soil sinkage/compaction/shear or calibrated pneumatic tyre.
Spherical rolling contact reference and ideal joint velocity servo; no actuator torque or battery dynamics.
Synthetic position fixes and assumed Q/R with known spawn prior; not GNSS/IMU receiver-level simulation or field calibration.
Innovation anomaly cannot distinguish bias from slip; protections and successful mild cases do not establish general safety.
Static planar scenes and serial homogeneous vehicles; planner is not terrain-risk-aware and does not replan for disturbances.
Energy remains a versioned post-hoc proxy. TB4 full routes and old bridge-exit stress counts were not rerun.

preceding_matrix_iterations.scope: Pre-final-guard experiments, preserved separately. Do not count as final guard acceptance; source fingerprints are saved per session.

acceptance_scope: Seven final nonideal runs, nine unaffected reference/fault runs, one final browser run. Twenty-two preceding matrix runs are separate iteration evidence.

guard_repair.scope: Mid-band innovation, stale observation gap and localization hold all reset continuous recovery evidence; degraded deadline remains bounded through holds. Final severe run failed after 30 s without qualified recovery.
